_metadata.label: AI-written and not expert-reviewed
_metadata.description: Interview room content for GenAI Engineer track (20 core questions aligned with Neural Mastery criteria, under-20-word spoken follow-ups, robust misconception detectors, natural transitions, and direct Neural Mastery practice links).

dialogue_rules.rule_1_advance_on_excellent: If all points are covered with similarity >= 0.50 and no misconceptions, move on immediately without probing.
dialogue_rules.rule_2_max_two_followups: No question receives more than 2 follow-up probes. Conclude and transition after turn 2.
dialogue_rules.rule_3_misconception_priority: A detected misconception takes precedence on turn 1, phrased conversationally using candidate words.
dialogue_rules.rule_4_single_gap_probe: If points are missed, probe the single most critical unaddressed claim in under 20 words.
dialogue_rules.rule_5_progressive_resolution: If candidate clarifies the probed point on turn 2, acknowledge and advance immediately.

spoken_transitions: Thanks for clarifying that. Let's move on to the next question.
Got it, that clarifies the trade-off. Moving to the next area.
Understood, thanks for breaking that down. Let's look at the next topic.
Makes sense, appreciate the explanation. Let's dive into the next area.
That gives good context on the mechanism. Let's move forward to the next question.
